info.description:
The course consists of 12 chapters. In one chapter are 2 reading passages
with the same theme, presented in 6 parts: 
Before
you read, reading skill, reading comprehension, critical thinking, vocabulary
comprehension 
and
 vocabulary skill
.
The aim of the course is to provide students with intermediate-level language
as well as social and natural knowledge regarding to such fields as education, culture,
sports, entertainment, occupation, advertising, food and environment. Through
the reading practice during the course, students are also equipped themselves
with reading skills as follows:
education, culture, sports, entertainment, occupation, advertising, food
and the environment
-
Skimming
-
Scanning
-
Predicting

-
Understanding inferences

clos.loDetails: Acquire the academic vocabulary that corresponds to Level B2 of the CEFR Language Proficiency Framework on topics related to culture, sports, recreation, occupation, advertising, and environment
Know how to analyze words, phrases, sentences to understand the contents of the reading passage

Apply background knowledge and linguistic knowledge to read positively, understanding reading content and the writer’s purpose and implications and apply the knowledge gained from this course in improving productive skills (writing and speaking skills)
